title: Tirzepatide Once Weekly for the Treatment of Obesity.
journal: The New England journal of medicine
excerpts: Coprimary end points were the percentage change in weight from baseline and a weight reduction of 5% or more.
The treatment-regimen estimand assessed effects regardless of treatment discontinuation in the intention-to-treat population.
